description: This file defines the Weibull class providing statistical distribution functions (PDF and CDF) specific to the Weibull distribution used within spreadsheet calculations, including validation and error handling.

classes.name: Weibull
classes.description: Provides methods to calculate the Weibull distribution's PDF and CDF for use in statistical analysis within spreadsheet calculations.

methods.name: distribution
methods.description: Calculates the Weibull distribution's probability density (PDF) or cumulative distribution function (CDF) based on input parameters. Supports array inputs and handles validation and errors.
